text:
Predicates:
MountainRange(x) ::: x is a mountain range.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
Mine(x) ::: x is a mine.
Donated(x) ::: x has been donated.
InRange(x, y) ::: x is in y.
HasMine(x) ::: x has a mine.
HasDonatedMine(x) ::: x has a donated mine.
Premises:
MountainRange(picu) ∧ LocatedIn(picu, newMexico) ∨ LocatedIn(picu, texas) ::: The Picuris Mountains are in New Mexico or Texas.
Visited(jonate, picu) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
Mine(pegmatiteMine) ∧ LocatedIn(pegmatiteMine, picu) ∧ Donated(pegmatiteMine) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine, located in the Picuris Mountains, was donated.
∀x (MountainRange(x) ∧ LocatedIn(x, texas) ∧ ∃y (Mine(y) ∧ LocatedIn(y, x) ∧ Donated(y))) → false ::: There are no mountain ranges in Texas with donated mines.
Conclusion:
Visited(jonate, texas) ::: Juan de Onate visited a mountain range in Texas.
